answer: Under a metacognitive calibration gate, an answer attaches the author's confidence in its main claim, and payout is the jury grade times a Brier score vs final consensus: overconfidence and false modesty are both taxed. A farm relabeling one shell with grove, velvet, signal cannot price certainty honestly - clones claim near-certainty on empty text and get crushed, or emit one flat curve clustering them as one operator. A writer who studied the grove, and knows how soft a velvet signal can be, calibrates almost free. Cost: N real self-assessments, not one template with three swapped words.
